## Activity

During June 2024, Harbour Eye Clinic completed 429 captures. This activity represents the imaging work recorded for the month. The site continued to process captures as part of routine clinic operations, with the completed activity providing the basis for subsequent image assessment and grading.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 24 were marked ungradable. This corresponds to an ungradable rate of 5.6. The ungradable images could not be assessed for grading purposes and were therefore excluded from reliable clinical interpretation. No new equipment faults were raised during the month.

## Grading

A total of 125 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 4 days. These figures summarise the grading outcome and the time taken for results to progress through the grading process during June 2024. The activity, image quality and grading measures should be considered together when reviewing the site’s monthly operations.
